Hi Tessa,

I'm Alex, one of the core maintainers at Lumen ML — we run a small foundation supporting model tooling for research groups. A few months ago several of our contributors started experimenting with Redwood's hosted API and it's been a big help. We're running low on credits for the next quarter and wanted to request a sponsor-match grant to keep CI tests and release infra running.

High-level ask:
- 50k free tokens for the next 3 months (to cover CI, model evals, and demo infra)
- Option to extend an additional 3 months if usage stays within projection

I've attached a short benefits form and a 3-month usage projection. Happy to answer questions — we try to be transparent about public-use cases.

Thanks,

https://lumen-ml.org

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear request and for sending the projection. Appreciate the details.

Quick answers:
- We can generally approve grants in the PLG maintainer program up to 50k tokens for projects that meet our stewardship criteria.
- I need a short internal approval from our grants reviewer and commercial lead (looping Ben).

Next steps:

2) Alex, could you confirm whether any of the requested usage will touch customer data or require a Private deployment? You indicated public research workloads, but want to be explicit.

If all good, I'll route this for final sign-off and issue the credits from the self-serve ledger.
